title: R24 TABLESTYLE cell-alignment value transport

source.specification: Open Design Specification for .dwg files v5.4.1, §20.4.101.3
source.finding: BL group 94 defines nine cell alignments: top/middle/bottom crossed with left/center/right, encoded 1 through 9.

implementation.behavior: The AC1024 TABLESTYLE DXF writer admits all documented cell-alignment values 1–9 on the table cell style and custom cell styles, while retaining the other style/profile gates. It rejects 0 and values above 9; the test specifically checks 10 before destination replacement.

validation.result: Build passed; focused CTest passed 1/1. Generated ASCII and Binary controls vary the custom styles across documented alignments, verify exact raw group-94 positions and typed readback, refuse 10 with destination preservation, and retry successfully on the same adapter.

qualificationLimits: Generated codec controls do not qualify independent producer wire behavior.
Native TABLESTYLE alignment behavior remains unqualified.
No whole-file DWG/DXF support claim is promoted.
